spatial_flow_description: Use a left-to-right upper decision flow and a clearly separated lower evidence lane. Upper left is a dashed “冻结策略” box with “当前工具版本”. It feeds “执行前证据”, containing “上下文｜已观察历史”, then “行动校准”, containing “动作正确性概率”. At the right fan out into four alternative action boxes in one vertical stack: “执行”, “追加验证”, “有限重规划”, “拒绝”. In the lower evidence lane place “独立校准集”, feeding “影子执行标签” with “仅供校准与审计”. Route this evidence upward directly into the calibration box; it must never enter the execution-before-evidence box. At the bottom put two separate assessment boxes: “概率评价” with “Brier／NLL”, and “任务评价” with “风险｜覆盖率｜完成率｜成本”. Calibration links to probability evaluation; the decision group links to task evaluation. Keep evaluation paths thin and distinct from decision arrows. There are no risk curves, numerical results, or claims of guaranteed safety.
caption_note: 路线四：冻结策略后独立校准，并根据执行前可用证据选择行动。影子标签仅用于可重置沙箱中的校准和审计；概率评分与同覆盖率任务风险分别评价。
No measurements or pre-experiment results are rendered.
RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: White canvas and WHITE box fills with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
At most three blue chromatic colors plus neutrals.
Native structural rectangles, dividers and connectors only; every main block has a geometric anchor.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Dashed borders for frozen modules; dashed arrows for feedback or unverified mechanism.
No overall title, invented formulas, dimensions or performance numbers.
Readable simplified Chinese, no cropping or overlapping labels.
